materials.coordinate_rule: abs(world normal X/Y/Z) weights left/top/right anchors; +X is left and +Z right in the reference positive-X/positive-Z camera quadrant

stud_wall_reference.scope: Opaque vertical standard studs in two Classic2024 books; no universal theme or transparent/sideways calibration

presentation.font_substitute: Helvetica / browser sans-serif; not LEGOChalet60 or CeraPro

pdf.source: Direct PDF path and transparency operators from projected/clipped SVG geometry, no SVG screenshot or bitmap conversion

limits: Illustration only; projection is recorded in camera, not physical assembly validation.
